name: Ourense (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Ourense (a lion and a bridge above waves on white) with a column of white roundels along the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Ourense; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ourense arms — lion and bridge above waves on white
column of roundels along the fly
bridge and crown of the arms
